entries.title: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash

entries.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
entries.snippet: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

entries.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
entries.snippet: With 93% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

entries.title: Carney to push for closer ties at Canada-EU summit in Montreal

entries.title: Alaska governor orders probe into Democratic campaign's alleged links to same-name candidate

entries.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
entries.snippet: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

entries.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe

entries.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
entries.snippet: Xi's anti-corruption campaign has become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", observers say.

entries.snippet: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

entries.snippet: The acquisition of the warplanes comes amid ongoing fighting in northern Tigray region that started last month.

entries.snippet: The jailbreak began with a fake seizure and ended 36 hours later with all the inmates back behind bars.

entries.snippet: A micro-drama will use AI-assisted technology to edit old episodes of the Australian TV soap to focus on Margot Robbie's character.

entries.title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs

entries.snippet: The monarch is in the Bahamas as part of a tour of the Caribbean during which he addressed the "great suffering of the past".

entries.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
entries.snippet: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.

entries.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
entries.snippet: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

entries.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
entries.snippet: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.

entries.title: State ballots let voters decide on abortion, taxes, transgender restrictions
entries.snippet: Missouri voters could ban abortion - after they just removed a ban two years ago. California voters could tax billionaires 5% of their wealth.

entries.title: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3
entries.snippet: An NPR analysis finds 70 House districts where Democrats and Republicans are each investing more than six figures in advertising during the final few days of the election, including in deep red areas.

entries.title: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers
entries.snippet: American auto companies say they are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper — plus the fuel needed to transport their products.

entries.title: Business as a liberal art? Some high schools say yes
entries.snippet: Learning about money is becoming a growing part of the high school curriculum.

entries.title: Ahead of midterms, Missourians defend transgender healthcare
entries.snippet: The campaign to defend access to transgender healthcare for young people in Missouri is taking an unhurried approach to talking with voters about the proposed ban.

entries.title: Their colleges closed, but the government refuses to erase their debts, lawsuit says
entries.snippet: Federal law requires the Education Department to erase the student loans of borrowers whose colleges close suddenly. A new lawsuit claims the department isn't fully following those rules.

entries.title: Morning news brief
entries.snippet: Trump and Obama campaign at rallies ahead of Election Day, two reports will give latest insights on GDP and inflation ahead of midterms, Israel's election is deadlocked.

entries.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
entries.snippet: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.

entries.title: King Charles III can't escape Britain's role in slavery as he tours Caribbean nations
entries.snippet: Facing demands that Britain apologize and pay reparations, palace officials say Charles will reiterate previous comments that slavery was an "atrocity that forever stains our history," while stopping short of an apology.

entries.title: Russell Brand denies all charges as he testifies at his rape and sex assault trial
entries.snippet: The British actor-comedian acknowledged in a London court on Wednesday that he had been obsessed with sex as a younger man, but denied multiple charges of rape and sexual assault, saying the claims have had a "devastating" impact on his life.

entries.title: Trump calls for prosecution of Alaska Senate candidate Peltola over Sullivan name controversy
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump called for the criminal prosecution of the Democratic candidate running for Senate in Alaska on Wednesday after revelations that her campaign appeared to be involved in recruiting a candidate with the same name as Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan.

entries.title: New polls suggest surprising Democratic gains in red-state Senate races
entries.snippet: President Trump headed to Ohio to rally voters in a race that could determine control of the Senate. That stop comes after dueling rallies in another key state offered a snapshot of the divisions shaping the midterm elections. Liz Landers reports.

entries.title: UN condemns U.S. economic embargo of Cuba though more nations sit out amid Trump push
entries.snippet: The U.N. General Assembly condemned the U.S. economic embargo of Cuba for the 34th year on Wednesday, even as Washington's campaign to influence the outcome led to a number of countries voting against the resolution or sitting out the decision for the first time.

entries.title: What's next for Israel after election produces political gridlock

entries.title: Shock, anger and mourning in Spain after 2nd major train crash this year
entries.snippet: There is shock, anger and mourning in Spain after the second fatal train crash this year. At least 68 people have died in what is now the deadliest collision there in more than a decade. William Brangham reports.

entries.title: News Wrap: Fed holds interest rates unchanged as inflation remains elevated

entries.snippet: To discuss how the midterm races are shaping up in the final days, Amna Nawaz sat down with Democratic strategist Mo Elleithee and Republican strategist Doug Heye.

entries.title: Remembering pioneering labor leader and civil rights icon Dolores Huerta
entries.snippet: Dolores Huerta, the pioneering labor leader and civil rights icon, died Wednesday from cancer at her home in Bakersfield, California. Amna Nawaz looks back at Huerta's life and legacy.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump calls for Peltola to drop out after report her campaign helped recruit 2nd Dan Sullivan
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump called for Mary Peltola to leave Alaska's Senate race and be prosecuted on Wednesday.

entries.title: Alvin Hellerstein, federal judge who handled cases on Trump, Maduro and 9/11, dies at 92
entries.snippet: Just two weeks ago, Hellerstein presided over the arraignment of former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and Maduro's wife, Cilia Flores, on torture charges that were added to their ongoing narco-terrorism conspiracy case.

entries.title: 4 takeaways from Israel's inconclusive election
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is down but not out.

entries.title: American taxpayers' bill for Iran war grows to estimated $47.1 billion
entries.snippet: The Republican president has said new strikes on Iran are an option after the midterms and is sending more military resources to the Middle East, despite initially promising Americans a military campaign that would last only a matter of weeks.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Obama stumps for Ossoff and Bottoms at Georgia midterm rally
entries.snippet: Former President Barack Obama, the last Democratic president to serve two terms, is increasingly campaigning for his party, acting as a foil to President Donald Trump.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Ukraine: 13 killed in Russian drone strike on crowded Dnipro train station
entries.snippet: A jet-powered drone struck a crowded platform at a civilian station in Dnipro, killing and injuring passengers who were waiting to board a train. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy called the attack "horrific."

entries.title: Germany news: Volkswagen posts 3rd quarter losses of nearly €6 billion amid competition from China
entries.snippet: Germany's largest car maker reported third quarter losses of €5.8 billion as its major financial struggles continue. And Chancellor Friedrich Merz concludes his tour of Asia with a visit to South Korea. DW has more.

entries.title: European Central Bank (ECB) head Christine Lagarde to step down in February, before her term ends
entries.snippet: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde is to resign nine months ahead of the end of her 8-year term. European Council President Antonio Costa has said the process to find a successor is underway.

entries.title: Ship reported on fire off Oman as Iran escalation fears mount
entries.snippet: A ship in the Strait of Hormuz is reported to be on fire, a British maritime agency says. Iran has meanwhile said it has shot down another US drone as military tensions with Washington continue.

entries.title: Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany's health scare highlights the need for better support for elite coaches
entries.snippet: Vincent Kompany’s health concern is a reminder that elite football's pressures affect coaches too. Better support, clearer structures and mental health safeguards are increasingly vital.

entries.title: Spain train crash: PM Sanchez calls for investigation as 3 days of mourning begins
entries.snippet: Emergency crews worked through the night after a high-speed train collision killed 68 people. PM Pedro Sanchez has pledged a full investigation into Spain's second major train accident this year.

entries.title: India news: 'Cockroaches' back Gandhi's rally against election chief
entries.snippet: The CJP said it would lend its support to any organization fighting for free and fair elections in India, including the opposition alliance. Also, India's right-wing RSS has a group of well wishers in the US. Follow DW.

entries.title: Israel election: Netanyahu-led bloc holds lead with nearly 90% of votes counted
entries.snippet: With nearly 90% of votes counted, the pro-Netanyahu bloc is just ahead of the anti-Netanyahu bloc, but neither grouping is expected to win a majority, with tough coalition talks ahead. Follow DW.

entries.title: North Korea fires around 10 ballistic missiles into sea
entries.snippet: The latest ballistic missile launch comes amid rising border tensions with South Korea and uncertainty over potential nuclear talks with the US.

entries.title: US: Department of Homeland Security data leak exposes details of more than 40,000 employees
entries.snippet: The leaked information reportedly includes names, phone numbers and email addresses of personnel across several US security agencies. This follows recent data breaches involving the FBI and the Defense Department.

entries.title: EU countries block Canada's 'associate membership' plan
entries.snippet: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen wanted to give Canada a special status within the EU. But Germany and other member states have raised objections ahead of a summit in Montreal.

entries.title: Flavio Bolsonaro lands in US, declares himself 'leader' of Brazil
entries.snippet: Flavio Bolsonaro declared himself the rightful leader of his country despite losing the presidential election runoff on Sunday. He and his family have fled to the US.

entries.title: US midterms: What you need to know
entries.snippet: US voters are electing a new Congress. The results will be decisive for the future of the United States, and a judgment on Donald Trump's second term as president.

entries.title: Evacuation from Oleshky: How are preparations going?
entries.snippet: A lawyer with the Save Ukraine Foundation, Myroslava Kharchenko, told DW about what has been happening in Russian-occupied Oleshky since a temporary ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump took effect.

entries.title: One year on, families seek justice after election violence
entries.snippet: One year after Tanzania's deadly post-election violence, families are still seeking answers. A government inquiry recorded 518 deaths. DW research has documented apparent use of excessive force by security forces.

entries.title: What would a new Israeli government mean for Arab neighbors? More of the same is expected, with some small positives predicted.
entries.snippet: A new Israeli government is unlikely to bring big changes on Palestinian statehood and troops in Lebanon and Syria, experts say. Some small positives may be possible though.

entries.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy irked by US-Russia-China summit
entries.snippet: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has voiced his concerns about a probable meeting between the leaders of the US, China and Russia next month. Plus, a localized truce appeared to be holding in the town of Oleshky.

entries.title: Spanish train crash leaves 68 dead, PM Sanchez declares 3 days of mourning
entries.snippet: Two high-speed trains carrying hundreds of passengers collided south of Madrid. Spain's transport minister said one of the trains was told to continue its journey despite a "red signal" being in effect.

entries.title: Is Iran headed to war or peace after Mecca alliance meeting?
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey have taken their latest peace push directly to Tehran. Officially, it was to avert a new military escalation, but their diplomatic outreach can also be seen as a warning to Iran.
